zh-CN.name: weapp-vite
zh-CN.tagline: 用 Vite 做小程序工程构建
zh-CN.description: 处理依赖、路由、分包和多平台单目标构建。你可以继续写熟悉的页面结构，把构建链路交给它。
zh-CN.audience: 需要现代 Vite 开发体验、Vue SFC 和多平台构建能力的小程序团队。
useCases: 用 Vite 启动和构建小程序项目
使用 Vue SFC 和自动路由组织页面
向微信、支付宝、抖音等平台输出同一套工程

faqs.question: weapp-vite 解决什么问题？
faqs.answer: 它为小程序提供 Vite 驱动的开发和构建流程，并把 Vue SFC、自动路由和多平台输出整合到同一套工程中。

faqs.question: weapp-vite 支持哪些平台？
faqs.answer: 项目数据中列出的目标包括微信、支付宝、抖音、百度、快手小程序和 Web。

en.name: weapp-vite
en.description: Owns dependencies, routes, subpackages, and single-target multi-platform builds. Keep your page structure; hand the build pipeline to Vite.
en.audience: Mini-app teams that need a modern Vite workflow, Vue SFC, and multi-platform builds.
useCases: Start and build mini-app projects with Vite
Organize pages with Vue SFC and automatic routing
Ship one project to WeChat, Alipay, Douyin, and other targets

faqs.question: What problem does weapp-vite solve?
faqs.answer: It provides a Vite-powered development and build workflow for mini-apps, combining Vue SFC, automatic routing, and multi-platform output.

faqs.question: Which platforms does weapp-vite target?
faqs.answer: The project targets WeChat, Alipay, Douyin, Baidu, Kuaishou mini-apps, and the Web according to its project metadata.
